compatibility.detail: Qrevo S uses the Roborock washable filter product that explicitly names Qrevo S. Do not substitute the first-generation Qrevo / 2R3W filter.
Qrevo S uses the conventional single full-width roller listed by Roborock for Qrevo S. DuoDivide assemblies are different.
Roborock lists the black two-piece side-brush product for Qrevo S. Match the brush color and screw mount.
The round spinning cloths are a separate consumable from their plastic mounts; confirm the cloth shape and attachment.
Choose the listing's “White-Qrevo Dust Bags” variation and verify Qrevo S in the details. A product option named Qrevo S Pro alone does not prove compatibility.

careTip: Roborock requires a rinsed washable filter to dry for at least 24 hours before reinstallation. Clear hair from the roller and side brush during routine cleaning, and switch off the robot before servicing it.

questions.question: Does the original Roborock Qrevo filter fit Qrevo S?
questions.answer: Do not assume so. Roborock lists a separate washable-filter product for Qrevo S, and the first-generation Qrevo filter listings can exclude Qrevo S. Match the exact model in the listing.

questions.question: Does the Qrevo S use a DuoDivide main brush?
questions.answer: No. Roborock lists the conventional single main brush for Qrevo S. DuoDivide is a different assembly used by select newer models, including Qrevo S5V and Curv/Edge family models.

questions.question: Are these all genuine Roborock parts?
questions.answer: The washable filter and black side-brush listings are Roborock branded. The roller, mop cloths and dock bags are third-party products, labeled separately; DustMigo has not physically tested their fit or performance.

questions.question: How often should I replace Qrevo S consumables?
questions.answer: Roborock's Qrevo S manual recommends replacing the main brush and washable filter every 6–12 months, the side brush every 3–6 months and mop cloths every 1–3 months. Replace dock bags as required and follow the robot's indicator.
